message.content: For the California State Board of Equalization, District 2 seat, Sally J. Lieber (D) is the researched candidate. On antisemitism-education legislation, she supports implementing AB 715 and SB 48 and strongly opposes weakening them. On Gaza, she calls Israel "a safe haven" and "the United States' one true ally in the region." A 2024 CAIR Action guide, covering her then-county-supervisor campaign, described her as an "outspoken supporter of ceasefire and Palestinian rights," though it does not date the underlying statements. CAIR Action endorsed her in the general phase, and Vote for Peace rated her "Ally" and supported her. Muslim Dems and Friends of Alameda County and Congressman Ro Khanna also endorsed her. Among Israel-aligned organizations, Iranian American Democrats of California, San Mateo County Asian American Pacific Islander Alliance, and the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club endorsed her, the latter carrying forward a primary endorsement to the general. No other candidate in this race has a researched record.
